deals.title: Birthday bonus: 2,000 loyalty points
deals.details: Patients enrolled in Ayr's loyalty program get 2,000 points (worth $20) on their birthday. This is listed only on a third-party aggregator, so confirm the terms with Ayr.

deals.title: Card renewal: $75 off $150
deals.details: Patients renewing their medical card get $75 off an order of $150. This is listed only on a third-party aggregator, so confirm the terms with Ayr.

deals.title: Compassionate care discount 15% off
deals.details: Patients on SSDI and government assistance programs save 15% on every order.

deals.title: First purchase: 30% off + free item
deals.details: New patients get 30% off their first purchase plus a free pre-roll or kynd soft chew pack. Requires valid ID and a Florida medical cannabis card.

deals.title: Healthcare & cannabis industry worker discount 25%  off
deals.details: Ayr's official page lists medical professionals and providers at 25% off every day. It lists cannabis industry workers separately, at 15% on that page, and third-party sites say 25%. Proof of employment is required.

deals.title: Pediatric patient discount 50% off
deals.details: Patients under 18 get 50% off any physician-recommended product. It can't be combined with other discounts.

deals.title: Second purchase: 40% off + free item
deals.details: Second purchase gets 40% off plus a free Entourage or Haze vape, or a kynd or Big Pete's edible. Requires valid ID and a Florida medical cannabis card.

deals.title: Senior (55+) discount
deals.details: Patients aged 55 and older get a standing discount. Ayr's discount-programs page lists it at 25% off, but a third-party aggregator lists 15%.

deals.title: Student & educator discount 15% off
deals.details: College students and educators get 15% off every day with proof of status.

deals.title: Third purchase: 50% off + free item + 3,000 points
deals.details: Third purchase gets 50% off, a free 3.5g flower, 1g Haze concentrate or any edible, and 3,000 reward points. Requires valid ID and a Florida medical cannabis card.

deals.title: Veterans & first responders 25% off
deals.details: Veterans and retired first responders get 25% off every day with valid ID, such as military ID, DD214 or VA card. Ayr's discounts page also mentions nurses as eligible.

deals.title: New patient: 1 free product with first purchase
deals.details: First-visit customers get one free product with a purchase. The free item must be priced the same as or lower than the purchased item's sale price.

deals.title: College student discount: 15% off non-sale items
deals.details: College students get 15% off non-sale items.

deals.title: New patient 2nd visit: free pre-roll or edible
deals.details: On a second visit, patients get one free pre-roll or one free edibles unit with a purchase.

deals.title: Refer a friend: $20 off for both
deals.details: The referred friend gets $20 off, and the patient who referred them gets $20 as well.

deals.title: Senior discount: 20% off non-sale items (55+)
deals.details: Patients aged 55 and older get 20% off non-sale items.

deals.title: Veteran discount: 20% off non-sale items
deals.details: Veterans get 20% off non-sale items, plus an extra 10% off items already on sale.

deals.title: 40% Off First-Time Patient Order
deals.details: New patients get 40% off their entire first order, per Eden's FAQ. It applies to the first order only.

deals.title: $30 Live Rosin AIO
deals.details: Eden's homepage lists a $30 price on a live rosin all-in-one vape as a current special. Product selection and limits weren't visible to me.

deals.title: Eden Loyalty & Rewards program
deals.details: Patients earn points on pre-tax spending, starting at 0.1 point per dollar, with higher earn rates (multipliers) as spending rises. Accounts are enrolled automatically once created.

deals.title: Munchie Monday
deals.details: Eden's homepage and Orlando menu list Munchie Monday as a current featured special. The discount amount wasn't visible to me, so check the specials page for what's included.

deals.title: Senior discount: 20% off (55+)
deals.details: Standing 20% discount for patients aged 55 and older. Taken from a third-party deals aggregator, not confirmed on Fluent's official site.

deals.title: Veterans & spouses: 20% off
deals.details: Standing 20% discount for veterans. The aggregator's listing does not mention spouses, and it is not confirmed on Fluent's official site.

deals.title: $18 1/8ths daily deal
deals.details: Goldflower's Tampa deals page lists eighth-ounce flower at $18 as a daily deal. Strains and stock vary, so check the menu.

deals.title: $75 Value 1/2 ounces
deals.details: Goldflower's Largo deals page lists half-ounce flower at a $75 value price as a daily deal. Strains and stock vary, so check the menu.

deals.title: Card renewal: $75 off $150
deals.details: $75 off an order of $150 or more when the patient renews their Florida medical marijuana license. It can be used once per annual renewal period, with proof of renewal. It doesn't stack with daily or patient discounts.

deals.title: First visit: 50% off entire order + free pre-roll
deals.details: New patients get 50% off their entire first order plus one free pre-roll. Discounts don't stack and apply only to medicated products.

deals.title: Free delivery on orders over $75
deals.details: Delivery is free across Florida on orders over $75. Delivery orders under $75 are charged a $25 fee.

deals.title: Second visit: 30% off
deals.details: Patients get 30% off on their second visit. Discounts don't stack and apply only to medicated products.

deals.title: Veteran and veteran spouse discount
deals.details: Veterans and their spouses need a Veterans ID and a Medical Marijuana Use Registry ID card. Discounts don't stack and apply only to medicated products.

deals.title: 10% off on your birthday
deals.details: Patients get 10% off as a birthday reward.

deals.title: 25% off for every friend you refer
deals.details: Patients get 25% off for each friend they refer to Insa.

deals.title: 50% off first visit after renewing your med card
deals.details: 50% off within 90 days of a card renewal, and valid for 30 days after the renewal.

deals.title: 50% off your first 2 visits
deals.details: New patients get 50% off their first two visits. The second discount must be used within 90 days of the first; other restrictions may apply.

deals.title: Compassion discount: 10% off
deals.details: A 10% compassionate care discount for eligible patients.

deals.title: Insa Day: 10% off when you wear Insa gear
deals.details: On the third Wednesday of each month, patients wearing Insa-branded gear get 10% off. The next one is Oct 21, 2026.
deals.schedule: every third Wednesday of the month

deals.title: Senior Mornings: 15% off for patients 55+
deals.details: Patients aged 55 and over get 15% off Monday through Wednesday until 12 pm.

deals.title: Veteran discount: 20% off (40% for disabled veterans)
deals.details: Veterans get 20% off and disabled veterans get 40% off. Patients must show a Veteran ID Card, a DD214, or a driver's license with a "V" designation.

deals.title: 25% off first-time patient visit
deals.details: New patients get 25% off their order on their first visit to Jungle Boys Florida, per the Weedmaps listing. This comes from a third-party listing, so confirm the terms in store.

deals.details: Includes Northern Lights 1g pod at 40% off, Caramel Sea Salt 10-pack at 30% off, and $44.75 off Apple Fritter Savvy AIO. Offers are valid Oct 12-15 while supplies last, can't be combined, and require a valid recommendation.

deals.title: Annual medical card renewal: $75 off $150+
deals.details: $75 off a purchase of $150 or more. Usable once per annual renewal period, within 60 days of renewal, and you must show the Department of Health renewal confirmation email. Excludes Dr. Dabber and Puffco products.

deals.title: Buy 2+ featured pods, get a Side-Bar battery for $1

deals.title: First-time patient savings: 60% off 1st visit, BOGO 2nd, free product 3rd

deals.title: Pediatric patient discount: 25% off

deals.title: Senior (55+) discount: 10% off

deals.title: Veteran discount: 22% off every purchase
deals.details: 22% off each purchase. Show a current Veteran ID Card, a DD214, or a driver's license with the V emblem.

deals.title: 60% off first three purchases for new patients

deals.title: $75 off $150 card renewal discount
deals.details: Patients who renew their Florida medical marijuana card get $75 off a $150 purchase of full-price items. Once per year and not stackable.

deals.title: Free 1g pre-roll for your birthday week
deals.details: Patients can get a free 1g pre-roll during their birthday week, with no purchase necessary. One per patient and not stackable with other promotions.

deals.title: Leaf & Vine Smart Value pricing
deals.details: Promo graphic on the Bradenton page lists Leaf & Vine 5-pack pre-rolls for $16, 3.5g flower for $13, 7g flower for $20 and 14g flower for $35. No dates were shown, so confirm in store.

deals.title: 20% off for Teachers, College Students & SNAP/SSI/SSDI recipients
deals.details: Everyday discount for teachers, college students and SNAP/SSI/SSDI recipients. Loyalty members only, and it can't be combined with other discounts.

deals.title: 25% off for Seniors (55+) & Pediatric Caregivers
deals.details: Everyday discount for patients aged 55 and over and for pediatric caregivers. Loyalty members only, and it can't be combined with other discounts.

deals.title: 35% off for Cannabis Industry & Hospitality Workers (Mon-Wed)
deals.details: Everyday discount for cannabis industry and hospitality workers, valid Monday through Wednesday. Loyalty members only, and it can't be combined with other discounts.

deals.title: 40% off for Veterans & First Responders
deals.details: Everyday discount for veterans and first responders. Loyalty members only, and it can't be combined with other discounts.

deals.title: 50% off your first 3 visits (new patients)

deals.title: Try It Tuesday

deals.details: Phat Panda 7g flower is listed as 2 for $59 under "Panda Savings" on the official RISE Florida deals page. No end date is listed on the page.

deals.title: New patient 30% off first three visits
deals.details: New patients get 30% off on their 1st, 2nd and 3rd visits. The page says this discount can't be combined with other discounts.

deals.title: Veteran and active military discount
deals.details: Veterans and active military get a standing discount. The page gives both 20% and 25%, so confirm the exact amount with the dispensary.

deals.title: Industry discount 15% off
deals.details: Industry patients get 15% off. The page says this discount can't be combined with other discounts.

deals.title: Senior discount
deals.details: Seniors get a standing discount. The page gives both 10% and 15%, so confirm the exact amount with the dispensary.

deals.title: 15% off industry discount
deals.details: People working at a Florida MMTC or physician's office get 15% off every day. Bring an MMTC ID/badge or a pay stub to the register; non-stackable.

deals.title: 15% off senior discount (60+)
deals.details: Patients aged 60 and older get 15% off every day. It is applied in-store and is non-stackable.

deals.title: 15% off student discount
deals.details: Students get 15% off all purchases every day with a student ID. It is applied in-store and is non-stackable.

deals.title: 25% off birthday discount
deals.details: Everything is 25% off during your birthday month, redeemed in-store. Limited to one use per year and non-stackable.

deals.title: 25% off for veterans and spouses

deals.details: Five-day sale event shown as a banner on the West Orlando store page. The same page lists 50% off featured 14g & 28g flower (exclusions apply) and discounts on Good News and INSA troches. I could not confirm whether those product deals follow the same dates.

deals.title: Sunnyside Rewards points
deals.details: The Tampa store page says you earn points on every purchase made through your Sunnyside.shop account, calculated after discounts. I could not see the point values or redemption terms.
deals.locations: Tampa (confirmed on store page); other Florida stores not confirmed

deals.title: 1st & 15th: stacked Veterans + Financial Hardship discount (35% off)
deals.details: On the 1st and 15th of each month, patients who qualify for both the Veterans and Financial Hardship programs can stack the two for 35% off their order. No promo code is needed, but you must show proof of participation. The next date is 2026-10-15.

deals.details: New patients get 60% off their first order and 60% off their second, for pickup or delivery. No promo code is needed; the discount is applied automatically. Third-party sites mention a $250 cap per visit, but that isn't on the official page.

Surterra Wellness products: all-in-one vapes $14 (excluding Zodiac), Full Spectrum Oil $16.50, Pure Reserve Oil $22.50, tinctures $32, Theragels from $30, lotions $24, The Fix balm $18. deals.title: Double Loyalty Saturdays
deals.details: Loyalty Rewards members earn twice the points on any purchase on Saturdays. You must be enrolled in Loyalty Rewards before you buy. The next Saturday is 2026-10-17.

deals.title: Refer a Friend: $20 credit plus free pre-roll
deals.details: You earn $20 per referral, and both you and your friend get a free 1g pre-roll. The referral counts only after your friend uses your link and makes a first purchase. The credit stacks with daily promos and loyalty discounts that Surterra marks as stackable.

deals.title: Veterans discount: 15% off plus double loyalty points
deals.details: Verified veterans get 15% off and double loyalty points on purchases. It can't be combined with other discounts except Loyalty Rewards.

deals.title: 25% off first-time patient order
deals.details: First-time patients get 25% off their entire order, according to the store's Weedmaps listing. This comes from a third-party menu page, not The Flowery's own site, and I couldn't confirm conditions or limits.
deals.locations: Ocala (listing seen for this store; other Florida locations unconfirmed)

deals.title: Pediatric patient discount: 20% off every purchase
deals.details: Pediatric patients under 18, or their caregivers, can get 20% off every purchase.

deals.title: Refer a friend: 50% off your next order
deals.details: A patient who brings in a new patient gets 50% off their next order, and the new patient gets the same discount. Exact terms are not stated on the page.

deals.title: Tuesday 20% off for industry employees and medical providers
deals.details: Industry employees and medical providers get 20% off their purchase every Tuesday. They must show an employee badge or their most recent paystub.

deals.title: SNAP discount: 10% off every order
deals.details: Patients enrolled in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program get 10% off every order.

deals.title: Wisdom (55+) discount: 10% off every day
deals.details: Customers aged 55 and older get 10% off every day. Trulieve says it can change or adjust the discount at any time.

events.name: Cannabis Clinical Outcomes Research Conference (CCORC) 2026
events.venue: UF Academic and Research Center at Lake Nona
events.description: Sixth annual research conference from the Consortium for Medical Marijuana Clinical Outcomes Research. It brings researchers, physicians and industry leaders together to share findings on medical marijuana safety, drug interactions and health outcomes, with an exhibitor hall and some virtual attendance.

events.name: Florida CannFest 2026
events.description: Outdoor cannabis-culture festival with vendors, food trucks, live music, art and glass artists. It is 18+, and a new VIP early-entry option (9 AM) is offered this year.

news.headline: Green Thumb Opens RISE Dispensary in Cape Coral, Fla.
news.summary: Green Thumb Industries' RISE brand opened a new medical cannabis dispensary in Cape Coral on Oct. 10, bringing its Florida total to 25 locations. Lee County patients get another nearby option, and a grand opening event is planned for Oct. 31.

news.headline: Florida Nears 1 Million Medical Marijuana Patients as Growth Slows
news.summary: Citing OMMU's Oct. 9 update, the post reports 942,370 active patient ID cardholders and 782 dispensing locations, about 57,600 short of one million. It says patient growth over the past year (about 1.8%) is slower than dispensary growth (about 5%), which raises questions about competition and access.

site.title: Florida Medical Cannabis Daily
site.tagline: Patient discounts, events and news from across Florida, updated every morning.
site.disclaimer: This page is gathered automatically each morning from public sources and may be incomplete or out of date. Always confirm a deal with the dispensary before you go. This site is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or paid by any dispensary, and nothing here is medical advice.
